FROM user_task_answers user_task_answer JOIN tasks task ON user_task_answer.task_id = task.id JOIN gc_user u ON user_task_answer.owner_id = u.id JOIN gc_user_info user_info ON u.info_id = user_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file user_avatar_file ON user_info.avatar_file_id = user_avatar_file.id LEFT JOIN user_task_answer_reviews user_task_answer_review ON user_task_answer.id = user_task_answer_review.user_task_answer_id LEFT JOIN gc_user review_owner ON user_task_answer_review.owner_id = review_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info review_owner_info ON review_owner.info_id = review_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file review_owner_avatar_file ON review_owner_info.avatar_file_id = review_owner_avatar_file.id
JOIN user_task_answer_choices user_task_answer_single_choice ON user_task_answer.id = user_task_answer_single_choice.user_task_answer_id
JOIN user_task_answer_choices user_task_answer_multiple_choice ON user_task_answer.id = user_task_answer_multiple_choice.user_task_answer_id
JOIN user_task_answer_choices_pairings user_task_answer_choice_pairing ON user_task_answer.id = user_task_answer_choice_pairing.user_task_answer_id
JOIN user_task_answer_choices_fill_in_blanks user_task_answer_choice_fill_in_blank ON user_task_answer.id = user_task_answer_choice_fill_in_blank.user_task_answer_id
WHERE user_task_answer.task_id = #{taskId}
AND user_task_answer.owner_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY user_task_answer.created_time DESC
